---
title: "Decisive Experiment: Gradient Rate on a Disjoint Support"
subtitle: "Verifying the minimax rate at a 'harder' point theta_3"
format: html
editor: visual
---

## 1. Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Core libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)
library(progressr)
library(lhs)

# Load all our custom functions
source("../../R/data_generator.R")
source("../../R/solvers.R")

# --- LHS Generators ---
generate_epsilon_gaussian_LHS <- function(n, sigma2_eps = 1, ...) {
  hypercube_vec <- randomLHS(n, 1)[, 1]
  epsilon <- qnorm(hypercube_vec, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(sigma2_eps))
  return(epsilon)
}
generate_X_t_LHS <- function(n, p, df_X, scale_X = 1, ...) {
  hypercube <- randomLHS(n, p)
  X_raw <- qt(hypercube, df = df_X)
  X_scaled <- X_raw * scale_X
  return(X_scaled)
}
```

## 2. Simulation Parameters

```{r params}
# --- Fixed Model Parameters ---
P <- 600
S_STAR <- 5
THETA_STAR <- rep(0, P)
THETA_STAR[1:S_STAR] <- c(5, -5, 6, -6, 7)
scale_X=1.5
# --- KEY: Define the "hard" evaluation point theta_3 ---
THETA_3 <- rep(0, P)
# Disjoint support: indices 6 to 10
THETA_3[ (S_STAR + 1) : (2 * S_STAR) ] <- c(5, -5, 6, -6, 7)

# --- Best Scenario Parameters (from previous discovery) ---
BEST_SCALE_X <- 1.0
BEST_C_K <- 12.0

# --- Simulation Grid ---
LAMBDAS <- c(0.1,0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8,10,15)
#LAMBDAS <- c(0.2,5)
K_SEQUENCE <- c(1, 5, 9, 13, 17)
N_SEQUENCE <- round(300 * exp(0.2 * K_SEQUENCE))
N_REPS <- 200

param_grid <- expand.grid(
  lambda_moment = LAMBDAS,
  n = N_SEQUENCE,
  rep_id = 1:N_REPS
)
```

## 3. Main Simulation Loop (Parallel)

```{r main-loop, cache=TRUE}
# --- Setup Parallel Backend ---
num_cores <- max(1, detectCores() - 1)
registerDoParallel(cores = num_cores)

with_progress({
  p_bar <- progressor(steps = nrow(param_grid))
  
  results_list <- foreach(
    i = 1:nrow(param_grid),
    .combine = 'rbind',
    .packages = c("dplyr", "lhs")
  ) %dopar% {
    
    p_bar()
    
    # --- Setup for each task ---
    source("../../R/data_generator.R")
    source("../../R/solvers.R")
    # Re-define LHS generators
    generate_epsilon_gaussian_LHS <- function(n, sigma2_eps = 1, ...) {
  hypercube_vec <- randomLHS(n, 1)[, 1]
  epsilon <- qnorm(hypercube_vec, mean = 0, sd = sqrt(sigma2_eps))
  return(epsilon)
}
generate_X_t_LHS <- function(n, p, df_X, scale_X = 1, ...) {
  hypercube <- randomLHS(n, p)
  X_raw <- qt(hypercube, df = df_X)
  X_scaled <- X_raw * scale_X
  return(X_scaled)
}
    params <- param_grid[i, ]
    n <- params$n
    lambda_moment <- params$lambda_moment
    
    set.seed(i)
    
    # --- 1. Generate Data ---
    df_X <- 2 + 2 * lambda_moment
    sim_data <- generate_linear_data(
      n = n, p = P, theta_star = THETA_STAR,
      generator_X = generate_X_t_LHS,
      generator_epsilon = generate_epsilon_gaussian_LHS,
      df_X = df_X,
      scale_X = scale_X
    )
    X <- sim_data$X
    y <- sim_data$y
    
    # --- 2. Estimate Gradient at theta = THETA_3 ---
    K <- max(1, round( 12*log(P * log(n / log(P)))))
    
    grad_hat <- robust_grad_MoM(
      theta = THETA_3, # <-- KEY CHANGE
      X = X, y = y, K = K, 
      grad_func_samplewise = grad_linear_regression_samplewise
    )
    
    # --- 3. Calculate True Expected Gradient at theta = THETA_3 ---
    sigma2_x_scaled <- (scale_X^2) * (df_X / (df_X - 2))
grad_true <- sigma2_x_scaled * (THETA_3 - THETA_STAR)
    
    # --- 4. Calculate L2 Error ---
    l2_error <- sqrt(sum((grad_hat - grad_true)^2))
    
    # Return results
    data.frame(
      n = n,
      lambda_moment = lambda_moment,
      rep_id = params$rep_id,
      grad_error = l2_error
    )
  }
})

stopImplicitCluster()
```

## 4. Analysis and Visualization

```{r analysis}
# Aggregate results
summary_results <- results_list %>%
  group_by(n, lambda_moment) %>%
  summarise(mean_grad_error = mean(grad_error, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(
    log_n = log(n),
    log_error = log(mean_grad_error),
    lambda_factor = as.factor(paste0("lambda = ", lambda_moment))
  )
saveRDS(results_list,"../../results/05_Fifth_simulation_linear_model_n_vs_lambda/gradient_n_vs_lambda_raw_results.rds")
saveRDS(summary_results,"../../results/05_Fifth_simulation_linear_model_n_vs_lambda/gradient_n_vs_lambda_final_results.rds")
```

```{r}
#normalize the line
# Aggregate results by taking the mean of the gradient error
# We group by each curve (i.e., by lambda_factor) and subtract the first
# value of log_error from all other values in that group.
normalized_summary <- summary_results %>%
  # Ensure data is sorted by n within each group
  arrange(lambda_factor, n) %>% 
  group_by(lambda_factor) %>%
  mutate(
    normalized_log_error = log_error - first(log_error)
  )
normalized_summary$lambda<-as.numeric(normalized_summary$lambda_moment)-0.01
normalized_summary$lambda<-as.factor(normalized_summary$lambda)
# --- Verify the slopes ---
normalized_summary$lambda<-as.numeric(normalized_summary$lambda_moment)-0.01
slope_summary <- normalized_summary %>%
  group_by(lambda) %>%
  do(model = lm(log_error ~ log_n, data = .)) %>%
  summarise(
    lambda = lambda,
    empirical_slope = coef(model)[2],
    R_2=summary(model)$r.squared,
    theoretical_slope = pmax(-lambda / (1 + lambda), -0.5)
  )

cat("\n--- Comparison of Empirical and Theoretical Slopes ---\n")
print(slope_summary)
```

# install.packages("ggplot2")

actual_lambda_levels <- c("0.09", "0.19", "0.39", "0.59", "0.79", "9.99", "14.99")  
user_colors <- c(
  "#4F2982", #  (Deep Indigo)
  "#3B82A1", #  (Steel Blue)
  "#00A08A", #  (Teal)
  "#6DB38B", #  (Seafoam Green)
  "#A98C63", #  (Camel)
  "#E2C16A", #  (Ginger Yellow)
  "#F3E290"  #  (Pale Moon Yellow)
)


selected_palette <- setNames(user_colors, actual_lambda_levels)



plot_rates_normalized <- ggplot(
  normalized_summary, 
  aes(x = log_n, y = normalized_log_error, color = as.factor(lambda), group = lambda)
) +
 
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  

  labs(
    x = "Log(Sample Size, n)",
    y = "Normalized Log(Mean L2 Error)",
    color = "Feature Parameter (Lambda)" 
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Feature Parameter (Lambda)", 
    values = selected_palette
  ) +
  
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 22) + 
  theme(
    
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    
   
    legend.position = c(0.003, 0.006),
    legend.justification = c(0, 0),
    
   
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18), 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    
    
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  
  
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 3))


print(plot_rates_normalized)


ggsave("../../results/05_Fifth_simulation_linear_model_n_vs_lambda/gradient_estimation_error_vs_lambda.pdf", plot_rates_normalized, width = 8.2, height = 4.5)
ggsave("../../results/05_Fifth_simulation_linear_model_n_vs_lambda/gradient_estimation_error_vs_lambda.png", plot_rates_normalized, width = 8.2, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
